name: itch.io
license: Developer-published (free & paid), lots of new homebrew ROMs
description: Indie storefront where developers upload their own games directly, including new homebrew for retro consoles. Downloads are direct from the game page.

name: PDRoms
description: Long-running archive of public-domain and freeware homebrew ROMs for retro systems. Files are linked straight from each entry.

name: Homebrew Hub (gbdev)
description: Community database of homebrew for Game Boy and related systems, with in-browser play and direct ROM downloads.

name: Internet Archive (Software)
license: Mixed: check each item's license/rights statement
description: Non-profit digital library with a large software preservation collection. Rights vary per item, so check the item's license before downloading.

name: GOG.com
description: Legit DRM-free store focused on classic and retro PC games. Installers are downloaded directly once you own the game.

name: Steam
license: Commercial (many free titles, incl. retro collections)
description: Largest PC storefront. Many official retro compilations (Sega, Capcom, Konami, etc.) are sold here.

name: F-Droid
description: Catalog of FOSS Android apps and games with direct APK downloads and no account required.

name: Google Play
description: Official Android store. Requires a Google account; installs straight to your device.

name: PlayStation Store
description: Official Sony store. Sells re-releases of PS1, PS2 and PSP classics playable on current hardware.

name: Nintendo Switch Online
description: Nintendo's subscription service with official NES, SNES, N64, Game Boy, GBA and Genesis libraries.

name: Antstream Arcade
description: Licensed retro game streaming service covering arcade, home computers and consoles.
